description: Produce a governed, standards-compliant high-level design.
instructions: Design the system for the approved requirements in input.inputs.requirements. Allocate every Must requirement to a component, interface or decision. Record each significant decision with alternatives and consequences, identify risks with mitigations and trade-offs with the chosen option. For every MANDATORY ENTERPRISE STANDARD in your instructions add a compliance entry citing the standard exactly (source/subject@vN) – compliant with evidence, deviation with justification and a decision id, or not_applicable with a reason – and list it in 'citations'. Use lower-case slug ids for actors, components and nodes. Run design.check with {document, context: {requirements}} before answering and fix every error.
